operations.title: Entry 1150 closes the generic cyclic integral-sewing index
operations.body: Entry 1150 is verified. The occurrence-resolved six-to-three sewing matrix has SNF (1,1,1); each cyclic sector vector is primitive because its normalized e6 coordinate is 1. Restricting to physical pair sums gives 2I3 and (Z/2)^3, exactly the already known occurrence-identification multiplicity. No additional cyclic index exists. The next typed comparison is between these occurrence parities and Entry 301's enhanced-point (Z/2)^2 through the full labelled conductor map; they must remain distinct until that map is constructed.
